profile.name: CBox驱动的Transmon超导量子比特
profile.description: 一种通过微波脉冲、读出谐振腔和通量脉冲进行控制与测量的Transmon超导量子比特，并配合CBox电子学完成时序与采集。该器件常用于量子计算实验中的能谱测量、Rabi、T1、Ramsey、回波、单次读出、随机基准测试，以及通量脉冲和CZ相关相位表征。
profile.description_en: A superconducting transmon qubit controlled and measured with microwave pulses, a readout resonator, and flux pulses, using CBox-based electronics for timing and acquisition. It is used in quantum computing experiments for spectroscopy, Rabi, T1, Ramsey, echo, single-shot readout, randomized benchmarking, and characterization of flux pulses and CZ-related phase behavior.
